acceptanceCriteria.text: discover-related adds the RELATIONSHIP EDGE between the UseCase and the Class, not only the nodes — an added node with no edge is the empty-container class we fix repeatedly.
It adds the PARENTS of the discovered element to the diagram.
It adds the TRACEABILITY CHILDREN to the diagram.
Added relationships/nodes render on the diagram IMMEDIATELY, no refresh.
Idempotent: re-running discover-related does NOT duplicate nodes or edges.
Device-gated @390 real-WebKit, RED-baseline + STUB-MUST-FAIL, in the device lane so it re-runs.
